messages:
Maria C: Heads up — opened a docs PR to adjust console observability samples for idempotent dashboard creation; found a couple of broken links and a subtle race in the tracehook example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4628 :eyes:
Devon: link pls? looking
Maria C: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4628 — main changes: dashboard sample uses idempotency_key, tracehook now uses retry/backoff comment, and updated links to /console/dashboards and /trace-hooks
Sanjay P: saw the CI failure: link-check reported 404 for /docs/old-dashboard/examples
DocsBot: docs-ci — link-check failed on redwood-inference/docs@4628
Maria C: yep that's the one. The old anchor moved during the migration. I swapped to the stable path and added a redirect note.
Jen L: can we keep the example small — current sample shows full create + update which confuses readers. Suggest split into two snippets: create-with-idempotency and safe-update
Maria C: good call. pushed two snippets. JS:
```
await client.createDashboard({ name: 'app-errors', idempotency_key: 'req-{{request_id}}' })
```
Python:
```
dashboard = client.create_dashboard(name='app-errors', idempotency_key=f'req-{request_id}')
```
Devon: nit: use `idempotency_key` or `idempotency_key_hint`? backend uses `idempotency_key` now
Sanjay P: backend will accept both but only `idempotency_key` guarantees dedupe across retries. doc should recommend that.
Ryan: I can patch the link to the tracing runbook if you want — the current link goes to an old internal path. Which path do we want? /docs/observability/trace-hooks/runbook
Maria C: yes please, patch it. Also add a note about asynchronous callbacks needing to rehydrate KV cache if you retry.
Devon: ran the snippet locally, works. CI still failing on markdownlint line-length in examples.md
Maria C: pushing wrap fixes in a sec
DocsBot: docs-ci — build passed on redwood-inference/docs@4628 (after link update)
Jen L: can someone add a brief migration note: "If you used anchor X before, use Y now" — a one liner in the top of the doc
Maria C: added migration note and a short deprecation banner
Ryan: pushed the tracing runbook link fix -> PR updated
Sanjay P: approve from infra side, just confirm tests green
Maria C: tests green, merging in 10
Devon: :thumbsup:
Maria C: thanks all — will follow up if anything else pops up
